target: Immediately after logging in, she made sure to check her ensemble in the mirror of the room she was renting.

source: Seeing everything was in place and wardrobe malfunction was not possible (she wasn’t one of those ‘bathtub’ streamers), her blue hair was still blue and even her limited make-up was still in one place, she nodded and turned towards the table in the middle of the room.
target: Cum omnia in ordine essent atque defectus vestimentorum fieri posse videntur (non enim erat illa inter illos emissarios “balneae”), capilli eius caerulei manebant, et etiam parva ornamenta faciei in eodem loco constituta erant; annuit et ad mensam in media camera se convertit.

source: The room itself was nothing special, though thanks to her connections, which themselves were the result of her completing the quest she ‘received’, she could afford to rent one of the more expensive inns, with wide rooms, quality beds and actual baths.
target: Camera ipsa nihil praeclara erat, sed propter coniunctiones suas, quarum origo ex peracta missione quam acceperat orta erat, poterat conducere unam ex cauponis pretiosioribus, cum conclavibus amplis, lectis optimis, et balneis veris.

source: It cost some money to rent it, but she felt it was worth it.
target: Non parva pecunia expendebatur ad eam conducendam, sed videbatur id pretium valuisse.

source: Nonetheless, she wasn’t shy about making use of the opportunities to make money, thus being able to stream much more interesting things than the other streamers.
target: Attamen, non erat verecunda occasionibus lucrandi utendo, quo poterat res multo curiosiores quam ceteri emissarii ostendere.

source: Her popularity was climbing at a steady pace, though she was realistic enough to realize some of it was because she was a girl streamer, but she couldn’t do much about that…
target: Eius fama constanter crescebat, quamquam satis realistica erat ut agnosceret aliquam partem eius ex eo provenire quod puella emissaria esset, sed de hoc parum efficere posset…

source: On the table were several curious objects, a small box-like object, made of blueish-silver crystalline matter with several parts made of metal, three semi-spherical objects made from the same blueish-silver matter, and a spear with the head of the spear made from the same material.
target: In mensa erant varii obiecti curiosi: parvum obiectum, simile arcā, ex materia crystallina caeruleo-argentea confectum cum aliquot partibus metallicis; tres obiecta semi-spherica ex eadem materia; et sagitta, cuius caput ex eadem materia factum erat.

source: She first took the small box, slipped it into an equally sized satchel that hung on her belt and instantly a notifications screen lit up in front of her.
target: Primum parvum arcae sumpsit, eam in sacculum parīs magnitudinis, qui in cingulo pendentem erat, inseruit atque statim scrinium notificarum coram ea lucebat.

source: [Energy Shield Activated!]
target: [Scutum Energeticum Activatum!]

source: [Crystalline Energy Matrix Integrity 89%!]
target: [Integritas Matricis Energeticae Cristallinae 89%!]

source: Nodding to herself, making a note to herself to do some maintenance on the battery, she raised her left arm and poked at her very normal-looking bracelet.
target: Sui ipsam annuens et meminisse scripta faciens ut curam pilae ageret, bracchium sinistrum levavit et lorum quasi ordinariae specie tanguit.

source: Instantly, she was greeted by a holographic screen showing three lines.
target: Statim eam salutavit scrinium holographicum, quod tres lineas ostendebat.

source: [Crystalline Drone Number 00016 – Activate?]
target: [Dronus Cristallinus Numerus 00016 – Activare?]

source: [Crystalline Drone Number 00027 – Activate?]
target: [Dronus Cristallinus Numerus 00027 – Activare?]

source: [Crystalline Drone Number 00034 – Activate?]
target: [Dronus Cristallinus Numerus 00034 – Activare?]

source: Without hesitating, she touched the screen three times, and the lines vanished, replaced by an hourglass.
target: Sine haesitatione, scrinium ter tetigit, et lineae evanuerunt, substitutae horologio arenae.

source: Moving her attention from the small screen to the table, she watched with a satisfied smile as the remaining spherical artifacts on it shivered, then a small blue light flashed through them and slowly, but surely, began to hover about the table.
target: Attensionem ab parvo scrinio ad mensam transferens, spectabat cum risu contento, dum reliqua artifacta sphaerica fremuerunt, deinde parva lux caerulea per ea micuit et paulatim, sed certē, circa mensam levitāre inceperunt.

source: A second later, their awkward hovering was replaced by a much more confident hovering, accompanied by a slight hum that always comforted her.
target: Ante pauculum tempore, levatio inepta eorum substituta est levatione multo fideli, comitata leni murmuratione quae semper eam consolabat.

source: The drones were rather cute, in her opinion.
target: Droni, ad eius iudicium, satis lepidi erant.

source: They were each the size of a medium medicine ball made of two bigger parts.
target: Singuli erant magnitudinis pilae medianae medicaminis, ex duobus partibus maioribus constituti.

source: Their brains were composed of a bluish-silver spherical crystal material that she used her power on, basically programming them.
target: Cerebra eorum ex materia crystallina sphaerica, caeruleo-argentea, erant, quam ipsa viribus suis opes Loca ad programmandum adhibuit.

source: And the spherical material was held in a cradle of metal that had a small but cute face designed on it while two little stubs of metal with their own tiny balls of crystal hovered next to the drone as arms.
target: Materia sphaerica in cunabulo metallico tenebatur, cui parva sed lepida imago insculpta erat, dum duo parva fragmenta metalli cum globulis crystallinis minutis iuxta dronum ut brachia levitabant.

source: It had taken her several iterations before she was satisfied with their cuteness and functionality.
target: Multas exercitationes necessarias fuerunt, antequam de levitate et functione eorum satisfacta esset.

source: And based on her fans' reactions (and the multitude of fanart) she had made a good decision.
target: Et ex reactionibus fautorum suorum (ac multitudine imaginum fan) bona consilia cepit.

source: One of the drones was for shooting at the enemy, another created somewhat solid shields on her prompting and the last one created chains that immobilized (at most slowed them down, but she hoped with a few level-ups it would truly immobilize) enemies.
target: Unus dronum hostes iaculari destinatus erat, alter ex eius mandato scuta paulo solida creavit, atque novissimus catenas effingebat quae inimicos immobilizare conabantur (saltem eos retardabant, sed sperabat aliquot incrementis vere immobilizare).

source: With the three drones hovering over her shoulder, dipping and bobbing, she took up the spear which was also her creation.
target: Cum tres droni super umerum eius levitabant, oscillantes, sagittam, quae etiam eius creatio erat, tenuit.

source: One part spear, one part magical foci.
target: Quaedam pars sagittae, quaedam pars focus magicus.

source: As of now, thanks to her obsession with getting the drones right, she could barely do more than a few Magic Missiles and such, but one of her contacts has mentioned they had a lead on a crystal-based spell book so she was pretty pumped.
target: Nunc, ob obsessionem suam dronorum recte disponendorum, vix ultra paucos Missilia Magica efficere poterat, sed unus ex coniunctionibus eius indicavit se de libro incantationum ex crystallo composito indagare posse, itaque valde excitata erat.

source: Doing a final check, she took a deep breath, closed her eyes for a minute, then exhaled and activated her streaming app.
target: Ultimam recognitionem faciens, alium spiritum receptum habuit, oculos per minutum clausit, deinde exhalavit et applicationem emittendi activavit.

source: Putting a blinding smile on her face, she exclaimed, “Hello everyone! This is SummerRose and today we are going to check out that scaaaary forest!”
target: Risum fulgidum in facie habituens, exclamavit: “Salvete omnes! Ego sum SummerRose et hodie silvam illam terribilem inspiciemus!”

source: As she headed towards the door, the drones following her, she began to read the comments and started answering her fans.
target: Dum ad ianuam se dirigebat, droni eam secuti, commentaria legere coepit et fautores suos respondere inchoavit.

source: All in all, she was feeling pretty good.
target: Omnino, se satis optime sentiebat.

source: “Slathy! Go for the middle one!”
target: “Slathy! In medium age!”

source: The giant rabbit, now the size of a big child, didn’t show any reaction that it had heard Stephen’s order, instead, the rabbit immediately opened his maw, with teeth almost the size of a child’s forearm, and jumped at the lizard monster he indicated.
target: Lepus ingens, nunc magnitudinis ingentis pueri, nullam reactionem ostendit quod iussum Stephani audiret; potius, lepus statim os suum aperuit, dentes paene aequales brachii pueri habens, et ad monstrum lacertae indicatum saltavit.

source: Soon, their group was standing in the middle of the cavern, all around them corpses of the lizard monsters while their pets and companions were either lazing around or curiously sniffing the corpses or the rock and detritus thrown around.
target: Mox, cohors eorum in medio speluncae stabat, circumdatus cadaveribus monstrorum lacertarum, dum animalia domestica et comites aut inertia vagabantur aut curiosa cadavera atque saxa et reliquias circumiectas odorabant.

source: After he became a team with Slathor, Destroyer of Worlds, all of his friends decided that pets were cute so why shouldn’t they also get one?
target: Postquam cum Slathor, Destructor Mundi, coniunxit, omnes amici eius decreverunt animalia domestica esse lepida, et ideo cur ipsi non haberent unum?

source: So, excited at the opportunity, he took them back to the ranger who helped him, and after completing the quest to gather enough funds to pay the rangers to help them out, all of them got their own pets.
target: Ita, occasione excitatus, eos ad custodem qui eum adiuvabat reduxit, et postquam quaestionem ad satis pecuniae colligendam ad custodes solvendos perfecit, omnes proprias bestias domesticas adepti sunt.

source: Kim also got a rabbit, which made him happy, as it allowed him to spend more time with her.
target: Kim etiam leporem adeptus est, quod eum laetum reddidit, nam plus temporis cum ea agere poterat.

source: Though based on some of the looks he was getting from his friends, he wasn’t really hiding his intentions too well.
target: Quamquam ex vultibus amicorum suorum credebatur, suas vero voluntates non celabat satis.

source: Oh, well… Kim wasn’t complaining, so he wouldn’t say anything.
target: O, bene… Kim non querelabatur, ergo nihil dici velle videbatur.

source: The others got an assortment of other pets: wolves, bears, some more rabbits, somebody got a falcon, and one guy got a snake.
target: Ceteri adepti sunt variae aliae bestiolae: lupi, ursi, plures lepores, aliquis falconem, et unus vir serpentem.

source: It was a very judgemental snake.
target: Serpens valde censorius erat.

source: Stephen felt judged every time the snake looked at him.
target: Stephen se sentiebat iudicatum quoties serpens eum intuēbatur.

source: Those eyes…
target: Isti oculi…

source: As they walked out of the cave, bringing with them the spoils of their fights, they got to talking.
target: Dum speluncam exierunt, praedas certaminum suorum ferentes, colloquia incipiebant.

source: “These animals are pretty great! I can’t believe Stephen had such a good idea!”
target: “Haec animalia vere mirabilia sunt! Non possum credere quod Stephen tam bonam ideam habuerit!”

source: “Hey! Watch the name!”
target: “Heus! Attende nomini!”

source: “Sorry, I mean Cactus…”
target: “Ignosce, dico vero Cactus…”

source: “Hell yeah! My bear is the cutest of them all! But you know what we should do?”
target: “Ita, certe! Ursus meus inter omnes optime amabilis est! Sed scis quid agendum sit?”

source: “What?”
target: “Quid?”

source: “We should make a guild for people with animal companions!”
target: “Societatem constituere debemus pro iis qui cum animalibus comitantur!”

source: There was a moment of silence as everybody digested the proposal, and then the area was full of people talking.
target: Momento silentium orta est dum omnes propositum meditabantur, deinde regio plena erat hominibus loquentibus.

source: Apparently, everyone agreed.
target: Apparuit omnes consentisse.

source: Stephen just walked with Slathor next to him, hopping cheerfully (yet menacingly) forward, and looked at his friends happily.
target: Stephen modo ambulavit cum Slathor ad latus, laete (sed minaciter) saliens, et amicis suis cum gaudio intuens.

source: A guild sounded awesome!
target: Societas mirabilis audiebatur!

source: Dave struck down with his halberd, listened to the satisfying crunch that the troll’s head made, then looked over the ‘battlefield’.
target: Dave halberdā sua percussit, auscultans sonum satisfaciens a capite trol factum, deinde “campum belli” contemplatus est.

source: His elite kill team, empowered by the Life of Blood skill books, and the skill books that the Life of Blood skill books netted them, were going through the trolls like a scythe through fresh barley.
target: Manipulus electus caedendi eius, potentia librorum artium “Vitae Sanguinis” impulsus, et operibus eorum libris acquisitis, trolos percurreret quasi falx per hordeum recentem.

source: It was a stroke of genius to create the team.
target: Fuit ictus ingenii coetum condere.

source: It contained all his most loyal minions, all of them criminals for life, and he had enough dirt on them that none of them would even think about betraying him.
target: In ipso continebat omnes fideles ministros eius, quos omnes in vita reos habebant, atque satis notitiarum de illis haberet, ut nemo quidem de proditione cogitare posset.

source: The creation of the group was already paying dividends.
target: Constitutio coetus iam merces praebebat.

source: Thanks to being a small group, a lot of other guilds thought them weak and tried to muscle into their farming territory.
target: Quia coetus parvus erat, multae aliae societates eos debiles arbitrabantur atque in finibus agrorum eorum irruere conabantur.

source: But thanks to the power of his elite team, they were all soundly defeated, or stalled long enough for the rest of his group to arrive.
target: Sed propter virtutem manipuli electi eius, omnes graviter superati sunt, aut satis morati sunt ut reliquus coetus adveniret.

source: As his team finished the last trolls, he spotted his assistant in rather stupid-looking mage robes walking towards him with a frown on his face.
target: Cum manipulus eius ultimos trolos terminaverit, adiutorem suum in vestibus magorum stultos spectandos ad se sequi animadvertit, facie maesta.

source: ‘Probably not good news then…’ he thought, then called out to the man. “What is it?”
target: ‘Forsitan nuntii non boni sint…’ cogitavit, deinde viro exclamat: “Quid est?”

source: “We still can’t find him,” came the simple response.
target: “Eum adhuc invenire non possumus,” inquit simplex responsus.

source: For a moment Dave was confused. “Who?”
target: Paulo Dave confundebatur. “Quis?”

source: “Solar.”
target: “Solar.”

source: “I still don’t remember…”
target: “Nondum memini…”

source: “The guy who could use the sword and magic at the same time and killed one of our quote-unquote bandit groups,” his assistant explained patiently.
target: “Vir qui simul gladium et magiam uti poterat et unum ex nostris ‘latronum’ coetibus interfecit,” adiutor eius patienter exponit.

source: “Ah! Why the hell not?”
target: “Ah! Cur ergo non?”

source: “He simply vanished. For a little while we could follow him in Ironwood, but then…”
target: “Ipse statim evanuit. Parvo tempore eum in ‘Ironwood’ secuti sumus, sed deinde…”

source: “I see…” he mused, bringing up his hand to scratch his chin. ‘Should I grow a badass beard?’
target: “Intelligo…” inquit, manum ad mentum tollens terere, “Crescamne barba forti?”

source: “Should we continue to look for him?”
target: “Numquid eum quaerere pergamus?”

source: Dave thought about it a little but then shook his head.
target: Dave paulum ratiunculavit, ac deinde caput iactavit.

source: “Nah! Leave him be. He was a big shot then, but we are plenty strong. Especially with the money rolling in.”
target: “Non! Relinquite eum. Olim potens fuit, sed nos valde fortes sumus; praesertim cum pecunia ingens fluens.”

source: “Understood, sir,” his assistant replied and, based on the movement of his fingers, he was already sending messages.
target: “Intellectum, domine,” respondit adiutor eius, et ex motu digitorum iam nuntios mittere videbatur.

source: “How are we with the income from the skill books?” Dave asked, his mind back on the piles of gold they were raking in every day.
target: “Quomodo rem gerimus cum reditu ex libris artium?” rogavit Dave, mente ad montes auri cotidie colligendi revertente.

source: There was a moment of silence as his assistant checked something, then he answered. “Still holding around seven thousand gold coins. It fluctuates a little every time a bigger guild or workshop joins the game, but I think it won’t go higher.”
target: Momento silentium orta est dum adiutor aliquid inspiciebat, tum respondit: “Adhuc circiter septem milia nummorum aureorum retenta habemus. Paululum fluctuat quoties maius collegium aut officina ludi se adiunxit, sed puto non ulterius ascendere!”

source: “And the gold farmers?”
target: “Et agricolae aurei?”

source: “Real money is traded currently for ten to fifteen gold.”
target: “Nunc pecunia vera pro decem ad quindecim aureis commutatur.”

source: Dave worked over those statements in his head, doing a little math, then looked over the battlefield and his men as they were harvesting the trolls.
target: Dave dictas res in mente recensuit, paulo arithmetica faciens, deinde campum belli et viros suos, quomodo trolos metirent, contemplatus est.

source: They weren’t just valuable for their drops, but even for their bodies.
target: Non solum ad eorum detrimenta, sed etiam corpora pretiosa erant.

source: Sadly, they were getting fewer and fewer experience points for killing them, and they killed them too fast.
target: Eheu, minora puncta experientiae per caedem earum comparabantur, et eos nimis veloci occidebant.

source: Their respawn timer was just too long.
target: Tempus restitutionis eorum nimis longum erat.

source: They would probably need to expand their hunting grounds.
target: Forsitan fines venandi eorum expandere oporteret.

source: Making a decision he turned towards his assistant.
target: Decidens, ad adiutorem suum se convertit.

source: “Put out a call to the people we know that we are looking for players. We need more muscle.”
target: “Efferte nuntium illis quos cognoscimus: luditores quaerimus; opus est nobis vi ampliore.”

source: The assistant began to make notes, and he continued to issue orders. “Also, start planning a second elite team. Equipment, skill books and the contracts.”
target: Adiutor notare coepit, et praecepta dare continuavit: “Accipite etiam consilium pro secundo manipulo electo: apparatu, libris artium et contractibus.”

source: “Yes, Sir! Anything else?”
target: “Ita, domine! Quid aliud?”

source: Spotting a troll lumbering out of the forest, he shook his head and, with a roar, launched himself at the monster, his halberd raised high, ready to strike true.
target: Videns trolum ex silva laniantem, caput iactavit et, cum fremitu, in monstrum se coniecit, halberda alta extollita, parata ad verum ictum.

source: The studio was well lit, with all the bright lights and background items that one would expect a news program to use that was geared towards presenting news about games.
target: Studio bene illuminato, cum omnibus luminibus claris et rebus scaenicis, quae a programma nuntiario ludorum proposita utendi putabatur.

source: In the middle was a curved desk, all shiny and clean, and behind the desk sat an exceptionally beautiful woman.
target: In medio mensa curva, nitida et pura, et post eam sedebat mulier praeclara pulchra.

source: Her blond hair was carefully arranged around her head, her makeup was picture-perfect, her assets were artistically covered, and she was speaking with a smile that was worth millions.
target: Capilli eius flaventes diligenter circa caput dispositi erant, ornatusque eius ad imaginem perfectam constitutus, opes autem arte tegatae, et loquebatur cum risu pretioso quasi in milionibus.

source: With the advent of the VR gaming scene came the need for information gathering and sharing said information.
target: Cum adventu scenei ludi VR, ortum est necessitas adnotandi et communicandi informationes.

source: Thus the creation of internet channels on video sites that dealt with news about games.
target: Ita factio canalium interretialium in locis video, qui de nuntiis ludorum agerentur, orta est.

source: Then those, slowly over the years, grew into actual TV channels with everything that entailed.
target: Postea illa, annis paulatim transibis, in canales televisificos veros cum omnibus praesentiis formam ceperunt.

source: Including pretty presenter people.
target: Inclusis etiam pulchris moderatoribus.

source: “Welcome everyone, to tomorrow’s news today!” she spoke up, with a steady voice, looking directly into the camera.
target: “Salvete omnes, ad nuntios crastinos hodie!” inquit, voce stabilis, recta in cameram intuentis.

source: “This is Katie Marchik, and you are watching TGN!”
target: “Est Katie Marchik, et TGN spectatis!”

source: The video changed, showing the woman from a different angle, and next to her head was a small window showing a graph that had several very vibrant red lines going up high.
target: Video mutatum est, mulierem ex angulo diverso ostendens, et iuxta caput eius parva fenestra apparebat, quae graphum ostendebat, in quo plures lineae rubrae vibrantes alte ascendebant.

source: “Future Unknown’s recently released game, Magic Unbound, is continuing its rise in popularity.
target: “Ludus nuper ab Future Unknown emissus, Magic Unbound, ascensionem in popularitate continuat.

source: According to the statistics that were published by the developers themselves, and correlated by several independent watch groups, the game’s popularity has risen by two hundred percent.”
target: Secundum statistica a ipsis programmatoribus edita et ab diversis coetibus speculatorum independentium correlata, popularitas huius ludi ducentas centesimas ascendit.

source: A small banner appeared on the bottom of the screen and the presenter smiled.
target: Parva vexillum in infimo scrinii apparuit et moderator ridens fuit.

source: “If you want to know more, please visit our site for more detailed information!”
target: “Si plura scire vultis, quaeso nostrum locum visitate ad informationes accuratissimas!”

source: The scene changed again, and the window next to her head was showing several people standing in line in front of a shop.
target: Scaena denuo mutata est, et fenestra deorsum iuxta caput eius homines in caterva ante tabernam stantes ostendebat.

source: “Current research suggests that there is a steady decline in games sold, as Magic Unbound is currently dominating the gaming market.
target: “Recentia studia ostendunt diminutionem constantem ludorum venditorum, nam Magic Unbound mercatum ludi nunc dominatur.

source: It seems, with the high fidelity and very complicated levelling system, this new game has managed to grab everybody’s attention.
target: Videtur, cum alta fidelitate et systemate levationis valde implicato, hunc novum ludum omnium attentionem cepisse.

source: Both young and old.”
target: Et iuvenes et senes.

source: The woman smiled, shuffled the papers in front of her, and then continued speaking.
target: Mulier risit, chartas ante se miscebat, tum sermonem pergere coepit.

source: “Our research also suggests that many gaming workshops, including GoldenHare, BambooShoots and Silent Step, have made a decision to move their focus onto the game and leave behind their current games.
target: “Studia nostra etiam indicant plurimas officinas ludorum, inter quas GoldenHare, BambooShoots et Silent Step, decreverunt se intentionem in hunc ludum translatam habere et reliquos ludos deserere.

source: As you know, these workshops boast memberships in thousands and have several experts in their ranks.
target: Ut scitis, hae officinae sodalitia in multitūdine habent et plures peritos in suis ordinibus possident.

source: Their move will definitely boost the game’s popularity even further!”
target: Motus eorum certe popularitatem ludi adhuc augebit!

source: The woman paused for a moment, followed by an impish smile appearing on her face.
target: Mulier momento stetit, et deinde risus impius in facie eius apparuit.

source: “Of course, this fame also aroused the interest of the corporate world.
target: “Certe, haec fama etiam studium mercatorum excitavit.

source: “TGN has the word that several corporate research teams have been reviewing the possibilities that the game, Magic Unbound, could provide.”
target: “TGN fert verba quod plures turmae investigationis corporativae de opportunitatibus, quas ludus Magic Unbound praebere posset, recensuerint.”

source: The studio lights flashed a little, and when the lights died down to their previous intensity, the scene was changed back to the first one, with Katie sitting behind the desk, smiling at the camera.
target: Luminaria studi bene micaverunt, et cum ad pristinam potentiam redierunt, scaena reddita est ad primam, cum Katie post mensam sedens in cameram subrisset.

source: “And now, thanks to Future Unknown, we here at TGN are proud to present the latest trailer for Magic Unbound with actual footage from the game.
target: “Et nunc, gratias Future Unknown, nos hic TGN gloriantes sumus novissimum trailer pro Magic Unbound, cum imaginibus authenticis ex ludo, praebere.

source: Future Unknown has assured us that they used footage from real players and none of them were beta players!
target: Future Unknown nobis assecuravit se imaginum ex veris lusoribus usum esse, nec ullam versionem beta adhibuisse!

source: So, my dear watchers can rest assured you will be seeing real gameplay!”
target: Ita, spectatores mei dilecti, certiores eritis fore vos verum ludum videre!

source: The scene began to darken, and the woman spoke one last sentence.
target: Scaena tenebris coepit tegari, et mulier ultimam sententiam dixit.

source: “After the trailer, I’ll be here, and we’ll be talking with an expert in martial arts about them in the game Magic Unbound.
target: “Post trailer, hic ero, et cum perito artium martialium de illis in ludo Magic Unbound colloquemur.

source: Happy watching!”
target: Felices spectantes!

source: The video darkened fully, showing a fully black screen for a second, and then it was filled with all manner of colors swirling, while rhythmic music began playing.
target: Video omnino obscuratum est, scrinium totum nigrum per momentum ostendens, deinde cum variis coloribus gyrantibus impletum, dum musica rhythmatica sonare inceperunt.

source: On the screen, one could see a group of mages, in mismatched robes, pointing their foci at a giant tree in a middle of a swamp.
target: In schermo, coetum magorum videre poteras, in vestimentis disparatis, qui suos focus ad arborem ingentem in medio paludis digitabant.

source: The tree’s stump opened, and a massive maw appeared filled with nothing but darkness.
target: Radix arboris aperiebatur, et os ingens apparuit, nihil nisi tenebris plenum.

source: A roar could be heard, and then the mages’ foci all lit up and fireballs began bombarding the monster.
target: Rugitus audiebatur, et deinde omnes focus magorum lucere coeperunt atque globuli ignis monstrum oppugnare inceperunt.

source: The next scenes showed several craftsmen laboring over all manner of weapons, armors and artifacts.
target: Scaenae secundae pluries artifices ostenderunt, laborantes ad omnes genera armorum, loricorum et rerum mirabilium.

source: A blacksmith was feverishly hammering something with their hammer, while forge fire roared next to them.
target: Faber, cum martello ferventi aliquid pulsat, dum ignis in fabrica iuxta eum rugit.

source: A beautiful woman was humming, sitting next to a window and stitching a silky cloth in their hands.
target: Mulier pulchra submurmurabat, iuxta fenestram sedens, atque linteum sericum in manibus conscribebat.

source: A man covered in all manner of devices, both arcane and scientific, was looking through goggles at a small mysterious cube on a desk.
target: Vir, omnibus generibus machinarum opertus, tam arcane quam scientificis, per oculos speciales intuerebat parvum cubum mysteriosum super mensam.

source: Following that were several farmers tending to their fields, and gardens.
target: Sequebantur agricolae, qui agros et hortos colere curabant.

source: Alchemist harvesting and using materials.
target: Alchymista materias metiebat et adhibebat.

source: People venturing into forests for all manner of exotic flora and fauna.
target: Homines in silvas incipiebant, quaerentes omnes species exotericas florum et bestiarum.

source: The music began to speed up.
target: Musica celerius audiri incipiebat.

source: People fighting monsters, people fighting alongside monsters, even people riding on monsters.
target: Homines monstris pugnantes, homines simul cum monstris pugnantes, etiam homines super monstris vehentes.

source: A werewolf tearing apart sheep monsters.
target: Homo-lupus, monstrum ovinum lanians.

source: A man dancing with his sword through a veritable flood of giant grasshoppers.
target: Vir gladio suo saltans per inundationem veram ingentium locustarum.

source: Snake people besieging a village hastily barricaded, with the defenders looking through the gaps of the barricade.
target: Homines serpentiformes oppidum celeriter obsidere coeperunt, cum defensores per hiatus strati intuentes.

source: And so on…
target: Et cetera…

source: Finally, the scene darkened again, and the only thing that was shown was the name of the game.
target: Denique, scaena iterum obscuravit, et sola res quae apparuit, nomen ludi erat.

source: Magic Unbound
target: Magic Unbound

source: They were sitting in a pub on the shadier side of the town.
target: In popina sedebant in parte obscuriore urbis.

source: Everybody, even the servers were wearing cloaks that hid their features, and so did they.
target: Omnes, etiam ministri, pallias induti gerebant, quae vultus eorum celabant, atque ita illi.

source: Everything was covered by some kind of magical fog, which made it hard to see anything further than their table, which was its exact purpose.
target: Omnia operiebantur quibusdam nebulis magicis, quae efficiebant ut ultra mensam videre haud facile possent, quod ipsarum causae erant.

source: “So you managed to get something for me?” spoke up the man across from him.
target: “Ita quid mihi obtinuisse potuisti?” inquit vir adversus eum.

source: “Yeah, got into contact with a guy who finally could get me some proper answers.”
target: “Ita, contaxi cum viro qui denique mihi responsa apta deducere potuit.”

source: “And?”
target: “Et?”

source: “We are good.”
target: “Bene sumus.”

source: “Yeah?”
target: “Ita?”

source: “Yeah.”
target: “Ita.”

source: “Good. Anything else?”
target: “Bene. Aliud?”

source: “The situation in Ironwood is proceeding as we predicted. The guilds are still squabbling over the trolls, leaving us the bounty in the city. And this opportunity…”
target: “Res in Ironwood procedit ut praediximus. Guildae adhuc de trolis certant, relinquentes nobis praemia in urbe. Et haec occasio…”

source: “Yes, this calamity will allow us to properly take over.”
target: “Ita, haec calamitas nos recte superare sinet.”

source: “We still have a few steps in the quest, but my sources say that we are on track. There is nothing that can stop us!”
target: “Adhuc paucos gradus in missione habemus, sed fontes mei nuntiunt nos in via esse. Nihil nos prohibere potest!”

source: “Good!”
target: “Bene!”

source: The second man hesitated for a moment as he watched the other man sip his probably shitty beer.
target: Secundus vir momento cunctatus est, dum alium virum spectabat, qui probabiliter ignobili cerevisia sorbebat.

source: “I’m sorry to ask this boss, but was this shady darkness and cloak-and-dagger stuff necessary? Couldn’t we just talk in the offi…”
target: “Ignosce, domine, sed num hoc umbratilem obscuritatem et rem pallio-culterisque necessariam habuimus? Nonne simpliciter in officio loqui potuimus…”

source: He was, however, interrupted by the other man slapping the beer mug on the table, rattling it.
target: Intermissus est tamen a viro altero, qui poculum cerevisiae in mensam pulsavit, illud fremens.

source: “But think of the roleplaying!”
target: “Sed cogitate de ludis simulandi!”

source: The second man just sighed…
target: Secundus vir tantum suspiravit…
